resources.string: Let the assistant control the TV: On
Let the assistant control the TV: Off

Say or type things like \"pause\", \"volume up 3\", \"mute\", \"next episode\", \"go home\", \"open YouTube\", \"search YouTube for lofi music\", \"Wi-Fi settings\", \"وقف\", \"علي الصوت\". Simple commands run at once without the model. Media keys go to the app that is playing; back, home, screenshot and the power menu need quick actions. Not possible for apps: power off, sleep, TV input, tapping inside other apps.
